create_algorithm_subclass: create a subclass of Algorithm implementing _get_loss, _get_parameters, _get_policy_for_loss, _get_policy_for_collection, and process_batch abstract methods
get_loss_and_updater: get the cached LossModule and TargetNetUpdater for a specific agent group using get_loss_and_updater
get_replay_buffer: get a TensorDictReplayBuffer for an agent group with on-policy or off-policy sampling and optional prioritized replay
get_policy_for_collection: get the explorative TensorDictSequential policy for all agent groups combined using get_policy_for_collection
load_algorithm_config_from_yaml: load an AlgorithmConfig from a yaml file using get_from_yaml or _load_from_yaml static methods
